description: Default permissions for the main window. File system access does NOT go through the fs plugin but through our own commands in ul-core, which enforce a sandbox rooted at the workspace. The window permissions are the ones the frame in the interface needs: the window has no system title bar, so minimising, maximising, closing and dragging are ours to do. Nothing here reaches the updater or a restart: the page asks the core's `check_update` and `install_update`, the core asks the person before an install and restarts the program itself, and no capability grants either (`tools/verify-updates.mjs`). A permission a desktop-only plugin needs goes in `desktop.json`, since the Android build does not compile those plugins and a permission naming one fails the build script rather than being ignored.
